test_array_contains_expr: test the arr.contains method to check if array elements contain a column of values using expression API
test_array_contains_literal: test the arr.contains method to check if array elements contain a literal scalar value
test_array_contains_invalid_datatype: test that arr.contains raises InvalidOperationError when called on a List datatype instead of Array
test_array_contains_int: test the arr.contains method with Int64 array elements and integer search values
test_array_contains_boolean: test the arr.contains method with Boolean array elements and boolean search values
